name: Eventsquid
description_en:
Eventsquid manages event registrations and attendee operations with different paths for registrants, guests, groups, speakers or exhibitors. It can sell more than a simple ticket, including session access, goods, services or donations, with rules controlling selections. The attendee experience uses a mobile web app, while staff can use a native QR-scanning app.

Its annual license is quoted against expected registrations and use of the software. Unlimited administrators and events do not mean the quote is independent of registration volume. The contact-scanning app and professional-education tracking module are separately priced additions.
description_zh:
Eventsquid 通过不同路径管理参与者、来宾、团队、讲者或展商报名。它不仅售简单门票，还可安排场次、商品、服务或捐款，并用规则控制选择。参与者使用移动网页应用，员工则可使用原生二维码扫描应用。

年度许可按预计报名和软件使用范围报价，不限管理员与活动不表示报价不考虑报名量。联系人扫描和专业教育跟踪模块单独定价。

core_features.name_zh: 按报名者类型配置流程
core_features.explanation_en: Set prompts, pricing, payment choices and options for distinct registrant types.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为不同类型设置问题、价格、付款方式及选项。

core_features.name_zh: 网页参与者应用与报表
core_features.explanation_en: Provide itineraries and resources without an app install, plus custom report exports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 无需安装应用提供行程和资料，并可导出自定义报表。

en: Manage a training event with group payers, individual attendees and session choices.
zh: 管理含团队付款、独立到场人与场次选择的培训活动。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Configure payer/attendee roles, session limits and invoice status, then verify the web view, scan record and export.
steps.zh: 配置付款/到场角色、场次上限和发票状态，再核对网页、扫描及导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual fixed quote based on expected registrations/utility; specialist modules separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Minimum annual $4,725 is a 501(c)(3) example around 400 yearly registrations, not a universal quote. Actual license depends on volume/utility. Unlimited admins/events and core features; contact scanning and professional-education module extra. No platform card/refund fee does not eliminate processor charges.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 最低年费 $4,725 是约年 400 报名的 501(c)(3) 示例，不是通用报价。实际按量和使用范围定价，管理员/活动及核心功能不限，联系人扫描和专业教育模块另费。平台不加银行卡/退款费不等于支付商不收费。

sources.title: Award-winning event management software you’ll love using | Eventsquid
sources.research_notes_en: Registrant-specific paths, web attendee app, native QR scanning, VEO session organizer, reporting; homepage training counts and future badge wording conflict.

sources.title: Pricing — Eventsquid
sources.research_notes_en: Minimum $4,725 annual license specifically for 501(c)(3) around 400 registrations, actual quote by annual volume/utility; separate contact scanning and education module.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.en: Eventsquid describes single, group, guest, minor and third-party registrations, plus pay-now, pay-later and invoicing paths. For an illustrative training event, define who pays, who attends and which sessions each person can select. Check capacity, guest details and invoice status separately. An application may also need approval rather than immediate attendance eligibility; test the required business rule instead of treating every form submission as a paid booking.
sections.zh: Eventsquid 介绍个人、团队、来宾、未成年人和第三方报名，以及即时付款、稍后付款和发票。例如培训，应定义付款人与到场人及各自可选场次，分别检查容量、来宾资料和发票状态。申请可能需要批准而非立即获得资格，应测试真实规则，不能把提交表单直接视为已付预订。

sections.title_en: Distinguish attendee web access from staff scanning
sections.title_zh: 区分参与者网页访问与员工扫描
sections.en: Attendees can use the web app for itinerary, resources, session check-in/out and ratings without installing an app. Administrators can download a QR-scanning app. VEO organizes links to virtual sessions; that does not establish that all video hosting is provided natively. The homepage still describes on-demand badge features as coming in Q2 2025, so current printer availability needs confirmation rather than inference from an elapsed date.
sections.zh: 参与者可在网页应用查看行程、资料、场次签到签出和评分，无需安装；管理员可下载二维码扫描应用。VEO 整理线上场次链接，不证明所有视频都由平台原生托管。首页仍把部分即时徽章功能写成 2025 年第二季度将推出，不能因日期已过就推断当前可用，应确认打印能力。

sections.title_en: Do not generalize the nonprofit minimum
sections.title_zh: 不要扩大非营利起价适用范围
sections.en: The published minimum is $4,725 annually specifically for 501(c)(3) organizations with roughly 400 yearly registrations. Firm pricing is quoted according to expected registrations and utility. Core features, unlimited admin seats and events are described as included; contact scanning and professional-education tracking cost extra. Eventsquid says it adds no card transaction/refund fees, which does not waive the external payment processor’s charges.
sections.zh: 公开最低年费为 $4,725，特指约每年 400 报名的 501(c)(3) 机构。实际按预计报名量和使用范围报价，核心功能、管理员和活动不限，联系人扫描及专业教育跟踪另费。Eventsquid 称不加银行卡交易/退款费，不表示外部支付商也免费。

sections.title_en: Confirm training, data export and recovery
sections.en: Pricing promises four initial training hours, while the homepage also contains an older three-hour statement; confirm the contracted allocation. Custom reports can export XLSX, CSV or TSV and a REST API is described. Before rollout, reconcile one changed registration, a refund and the downstream report. Eventsquid suits investigation of varied registration scenarios; a minimal ticket page may need less setup. No account, API, onsite, refund or recovery test was performed, and source license/self-hosting remain unknown.
sections.zh: 价格页承诺初始四小时培训，首页另有旧三小时文字，应以合同确认。自定义报表可导出 XLSX、CSV、TSV，并介绍 REST API。推广前应核对报名修改、退款及下游报表。复杂报名情境可研究 Eventsquid，简单售票可能只需较少配置。本文未测试账户、API、现场、退款或恢复，源码许可/自托管仍未知。

research_gaps: No registration, VEO, QR scanning, badge printer, API, payment/refund or export was tested.
Training-hour conflict, stale badge roadmap, actual quote, external-video/processor costs, contract retention/residency, license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
